# DJ Pest

> DJ Pest is a family-run pest management business based in Warwick, Western Australia, servicing Perth's northern suburbs. In Perth pest management since 2011. Run by a Chartered Accountant: itemised written quotes, a treatment record for every job, and a written re-treatment promise. Technicians are licensed under the WA Health (Pesticides) Regulations 2011. DJ Pest Pty Ltd is a registered pest management business with the WA Department of Health (registration PMB 3000) under the Health (Pesticides) Regulations 2011.

Phone 0468 170 107 · ops@djpest.com.au · Hours Mon–Sun 7:00am–6:00pm. Legal entity: DJ Pest Pty Ltd ATF Johns Family Trust, ABN 86 797 740 716.
Service area: Warwick, Greenwood, Duncraig, Sorrento, Hillarys, Kingsley, Woodvale, Joondalup, Padbury, Craigie, Kallaroo, Mullaloo, Ocean Reef, Currambine, Kinross, Wanneroo, Marangaroo, Girrawheen, Balcatta, Stirling, Carine, Karrinyup, Hamersley, Balga, Alkimos, Clarkson, Butler, Mindarie, Quinns Rocks, Yanchep, Madeley, Gwelup, Westminster, Marmion, Darch, Watermans Bay, Koondoola, North Beach, Alexander Heights, Innaloo, Nollamara, Landsdale, Mirrabooka, Trigg, Pearsall, Doubleview, Osborne Park, Tuart Hill, Woodlands, Hocking, Ballajura, Scarborough, Joondanna, Beldon, Yokine, Dianella, Noranda, Edgewater, Mount Hawthorn, Glendalough, Churchlands, Wembley Downs, Coolbinia, Heathridge, North Perth, Menora, Wembley, Leederville, Morley, Floreat, West Leederville, Sinagra, Inglewood, Bedford, City Beach, Connolly, Jolimont, Subiaco, Embleton, Ashby, Daglish, Highgate, Mount Lawley, Shenton Park, Beechboro, Kiara, Bennett Springs, Mount Claremont, Tapping, Iluka, Lockridge, Bayswater, Maylands, Eden Hill, Swanbourne, Wangara, Malaga, Herdsman.

## Services
- [Pest Control Services Perth Northern Suburbs](https://djpest.com.au/services): Termite inspections and treatment, general pest, ants, cockroaches, rodents and spiders across Perth's northern suburbs. Licensed, itemised, documented.
- [Termite Inspection Perth](https://djpest.com.au/termite-inspection-perth): AS 4349.3 termite inspections across Perth's northern suburbs. Roof void, sub-floor, interior and grounds. Same-day report. Typical $250–$350.
- [Termite Treatment Perth](https://djpest.com.au/termite-treatment-perth): Termite treatment for Perth's northern suburbs: non-repellent chemical systems and baiting to AS 3660.2, certificate issued. Typical $2,500–$5,500.
- [Termite Treatment Cost Perth (2026)](https://djpest.com.au/termite-treatment-cost-perth): Termite treatment cost in Perth, GST incl: chemical barrier $2,500–$5,500, baiting $1,500–$3,000, inspection $250–$350. What moves the price.
- [General Pest Control Perth](https://djpest.com.au/general-pest-control-perth): General pest treatment for Perth's northern suburbs: cockroaches, spiders, silverfish and ants, inside and out. Six-month promise. Typical $250–$350.
- [Ant Control Perth](https://djpest.com.au/ant-control-perth): Ant control for Perth's northern suburbs. Coastal brown super-colonies treated with non-repellents and baits, not repellent spray. Typical $250–$400.
- [Cockroach Control Perth](https://djpest.com.au/cockroach-control-perth): Cockroach control for Perth's northern suburbs. German, American and Australian species treated with gel bait and growth regulator. Typical $250–$450.
- [Spider Control Perth](https://djpest.com.au/spider-control-perth): Spider control for Perth's northern suburbs. Redbacks and white-tails: webs removed, eaves treated, every retic box checked. Stand-alone $220–$300.
- [Rodent Control Perth](https://djpest.com.au/rodent-control-perth): Rodent control for Perth's northern suburbs. Species identified, entry points mapped, tamper-resistant stations and a sealing plan. Typical $220–$380.
- [Mosquito Control Perth](https://djpest.com.au/mosquito-control-perth): Mosquito control for Perth's northern suburbs. Breeding-site audit, residual treatment of the shaded harbourages where adults rest, timed for the warm season. Typical $220–$320.
- [Wasp Removal Perth](https://djpest.com.au/wasp-removal-perth): Wasp nest removal across Perth's northern suburbs. Paper wasp nests found, treated and removed, site treated, 30-day re-treatment promise. Suspected European wasps reported to DPIRD. Typical $180–$280.
- [Bee Removal Perth](https://djpest.com.au/bee-removal-perth): Bee removal in Perth's northern suburbs. Swarms referred to a beekeeper at no charge; hives in walls and roof voids treated and sealed. Typical $320–$480.
- [Commercial Pest Control Perth](https://djpest.com.au/commercial-pest-control-perth): Commercial pest control, Perth northern suburbs: documented programs for cafes, strata, childcare, aged care, offices and warehouses. Numbered stations, same-day reports, audit-ready folder.
- [Bed Bug Treatment Perth](https://djpest.com.au/bed-bug-treatment-perth): Bed bug treatment for Perth's northern suburbs. Every harbourage inspected and treated, growth regulator and desiccant dust, second visit built in for the hatch. Typical $450–$950.
- [Pest Control North Perth](https://djpest.com.au/north-perth): Licensed pest control in North Perth WA 6006, about 15 minutes from our Warwick base. Termite inspections, ants, rodents, general pest and vacate flea treatments. Itemised prices in writing.
- [Vacate Flea Treatment Perth](https://djpest.com.au/flea-treatment-perth): End-of-lease flea treatment for Perth's northern suburbs. Quoted from the address within the hour, same-week slot, certificate to you and your property manager within the hour of treatment. $150–$220.
- [End of Lease Pest Control Perth](https://djpest.com.au/end-of-lease-pest-control-perth): End-of-lease pest control for Perth's northern suburbs: vacate flea treatments and full end-of-tenancy treatments, quoted within the hour, certificate to you and your agent within the hour of treatment.
